bars.contagion_burn_reads_as_danger: ok (needs a before/after frame sequence, which its own '(guess: a sequence)' tag already says)

bars.contagion_sunbeam_reads_as_beam: PROBLEM: it describes the wrong object. RM_Sunbeam is a handheld gun (ParentName BaseGun, Verb_Shoot, a 3-shot burst of the projectile RM_Bullet_Sunbeam), not a device that drops a beam onto the ground. A screenshot judge cannot tell which frame answers 'a beam of light striking the ground': the item lying on the floor, a pawn shooting, or the arrest treatment. It is also filed under 'Helix devices' next to the Repulsor.
bars.contagion_flora_reads_as_flesh: ok (RM_Meatvine, RM_Toothmoss, RM_Eyebark and RM_Wombpod all exist in RM_ContagionFlora.xml)
bars.contagion_unfinished_read_malformed: PROBLEM (wording): 'and its kin' names nothing. The mod ships one Unfinished kind (RM_TheUnfinished ThingDef plus PawnKindDef) with one Graphic_Multi body, so a judge cannot know which other creatures count. 'Each visibly different' can stay as a target: the limb hediffs have 0 render nodes today, so the current build would honestly read NO, and that NO is work owed, not a flaw in the bar.
bars.contagion_coalescence_reads_as_mass: ok (guess; 'source of something' is loose, but 'a living mass' can be answered yes or no from a still)
bars.contagion_never_magenta: ok (a cannot-show floor carried from the concept sheet's leaf no_magenta, not a must-show that passes just by rendering)
bars.contagion_grown_limb_visible: ok: it is out of ### must show and parked as unchecked prose under '### Design Version 0.2.0 (not a bar of this version)', quoting the owner's move
